newsitem.title: USA: Oakley files patent lawsuit against Nike.
newsitem.headline: Oakley files patent lawsuit against Nike.

text.p: Oakley Inc. said Thursday it has sued Nike Inc., alleging that certain of Nike's most recently released sunglass products infringe on Oakley's XYZ Optics patent.
Oakley said it obtained the patent earlier this week and that it was the first in a family of patent applications it filed covering a broad scope of optical advancements it said it had pioneered.
"The awarded patent validates Oakley as the originator and proprietor of this technology and provides Oakley with a valuable tool to ward off other eyewear manufacturers," Oakley said in a statement.
"Our competitors often feel a need to use our inventions. While this is flattering, it is still not acceptable," it said.
Oakley, based in Foothill Ranch, Calif., said it has never lost a patent lawsuit, including having successfully won or settled cases against Bausch & Lomb Inc, Smith, Gap Inc., and Foster Grant.
A Nike spokeswoman was not immediately available to comment.
Oakley's stock fell $1 to $12.56, while Nike rose $1.25 to $62 on the New York Stock Exchange at midafternoon.
